press_references.value: Inuvo Posts Record Q1 2025 Revenue of $26.7M, up 57% Year-Over-Year

product_launches.description: Inuvo launched the enhanced IntentKey Self-Serve Platform, an advanced AI agent for audience discovery and targeting, in Q1 2025.

overview_description.description:
B2B trade across critical industries will become autonomous.

Nuvo connects suppliers and buyers in a verified network and gives AI agents the context graph to fully automate dual-party workflows across onboarding, ordering, invoicing, and payments, eliminating labor-intensive back-office tasks. We're building the vertically integrated trade clearinghouse from the ground up to transform the largest commerce surface on Earth.

Backed by Sequoia, Spark, Founders Fund, and Index.

product.name: Nuvo Intelligence
product.description: An AI-native order-to-cash platform that coordinates customer onboarding, credit risk, decisioning, and accounts receivable workflows in one system.

product.name: Customer Onboarding
product.description: A digital customer and credit application solution that validates submissions, automates verification and trade references, and routes applications through configured onboarding workflows.

product.name: Risk Management
product.description: A credit-risk monitoring solution that combines business, financial, banking, payment, and trade-reference signals to help companies assess applicants and manage customer exposure.

product.name: Accounts Receivable
product.description: An accounts-receivable automation solution for cash application, collections workflows, payment management, and discrepancy resolution intended to reduce manual order-to-cash work.

product.name: Decisioning Automation
product.description: A configurable credit-decisioning solution that applies business policies and verified customer data to accelerate approvals, credit reviews, and payment-term decisions.

product.name: Vendor Onboarding
product.description: A workflow for collecting, validating, and managing vendor information and documentation as part of B2B trade operations.
